description: SQ3R is a reading comprehension strategy with five stages: Survey, Question, Read, Recite and Review.
title: SQ3R (Survey, Question, Read, Recite, Review) as a five-stage reading comprehension strategy

description: The SQP2RS strategy, introduced by Vogt (2002) within the SIOP model, is a multi-step instructional framework for teaching reading whose steps are surveying, questioning, predicting, reading, responding and summarizing.
title: SQP2RS six-step reading strategy framework integrated with Writing to Learn
